blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: JEPA-style world models learn action-conditioned latent dynamics without reconstructing observations, but distributional regularization alone does not ensure that their representations preserve information needed for control. We identify static collapse, a failure mode in which the encoder preserves episode-specific static content while suppressing manipulation-relevant state changes. Because static content is temporally predictable yet diverse across episodes, this failure can persist despite regularizers such as SIGReg. A controlled study on OGBench-Cube shows that introducing randomized backgrounds substantially degrades planning performance while leaving the underlying manipulation task unchanged. To address this problem, we propose motion-guided contrastive regularization. Our approach compares predicted latent transitions with transitions to candidate observations from the same episode, reducing the usefulness of static background identity for distinguishing action outcomes. Optical-flow similarities provide soft contrastive targets, allowing candidates with similar motion to receive similar supervision. Combined with latent prediction and SIGReg, our objective encourages representations to preserve within-episode state distinctions and similarities between related transitions. Our method improves planning success over LeWorldModel (LeWM) from 52% to 78% on OGBench-Cube with randomized backgrounds and from 14% to 54% on LIBERO-Object, while maintaining comparable performance on four other visual-control benchmarks.
blocks.zh: JEPA式的世界模式在不重建观测的情况下学习行动条件的潜在动态,但单是分布式规范化并不能确保其表述保存控制所需的信息。 我们识别静态崩溃,一种失败模式,编码器在抑制与操纵相关的状态变化的同时保留了插曲特定的静态内容. 由于静态内容在时间上是可以预测的,但因时而异,尽管有SIGREG等常态化器,这种失败仍可能持续存在. 对OGBench-Cube的受控研究表明,引入随机化背景会大幅降低规划性能,同时使基础的操纵任务保持不变. 为了解决这个问题,我们提议以动向为指南的对比性规范化。 我们的方法将预测的潜在过渡与从同一事件向候选人意见的过渡相比较,减少了静态背景特征对区分行动结果的用处。 光学流的相似性提供了柔性对比目标,使具有类似运动的考生得到类似的监督. 我们的目标与潜在的预测和SIGREG相结合,鼓励表述,以保持整个国家内部的区别和相关过渡之间的相似性。 我们的方法提高了LeWorldModel(LeWM)的规划成功率,从52%到78%在OGBench-Cube上随机化背景,从14%到54%在LIBERO-Object上,同时保持其他四个视觉控制基准的可比性能.

LeWM and our method perform similarly on Cube, but LeWM’s success drops on Cube-RB and is low on LIBERO-Object. Our method achieves the highest success of the three in all settings.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: World models have attracted considerable attention due to their wide applications in robotics and autonomous driving. By learning environment dynamics to predict the consequences of actions, they enable agents to plan and learn behaviors through imagined experience ( Dawid and LeCun, 2024 ; Hafner et al., 2025 ; Micheli et al., 2022 ) . However, learning representations that capture critical state information without being overwhelmed by high-dimensional visual details is challenging.
blocks.zh: 世界模型因其在机器人学和自主驾驶方面的广泛应用而引起了相当大的关注. 通过学习环境动态来预测行动的后果,它们使代理人能够通过想象的经验来规划和学习行为(Dawid和LeCun,2024年;Hafner等人,2025年;Micheili等人,2022年)。 然而,获取关键状态信息而不为高维视觉细节所压倒的学习表述具有挑战性.

blocks.en: Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) offer a promising solution by predicting target representations from context, completely bypassing pixel-level reconstruction ( Assran et al., 2023 ) . It allows an encoder to map observations into latent states while a predictor estimates future embeddings based on observation history and actions ( Maes et al., 2026 ) . However, abandoning pixel reconstruction introduces a critical vulnerability to representational collapse, where the unconstrained objective trivially maps all observations to a constant embedding ( Maes et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 联合嵌入预测建筑(JEPAs)通过从上下文预测目标表示,完全绕过像素级重建(Assran et al., 2023),提供了一个很有希望的解决方案. 它允许一个编码器将观测图映射到潜伏状态,而一个预测器则根据观测历史和行动来估计未来的嵌入(Maes等人,2026年). 然而,放弃像素重建,则极易受到代表性崩溃的伤害,即不受约束的客观小幅地将所有观测结果映射到不断嵌入(Maes等人,2026年)。

blocks.en:
Considerable effort has been devoted to learning non-collapsing representations in predictive world models. Early approaches to prevent representation collapse primarily focused on constraining encoder updates, either through moving-average target encoders ( Assran et al., 2023 ; Bardes et al., 2024 ) or by freezing large pretrained visual encoders ( Zhou et al., 2024 ; Assran et al., 2025 ) . These methods stabilize prediction targets and achieve strong empirical results. However, they do not explicitly force representations to distinguish between different action outcomes, and frozen-encoder approaches additionally incur significant computational overhead from their large pretrained backbones. Alternatively, other approaches prevent collapse by supervising action information ( Ivashkov et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Sobal et al., 2026 ) . By employing inverse dynamics to recover actions from latent transitions or differences, these methods successfully establish meaningful state representations. Nevertheless, their supervisory signal is inherently focused on recovering the executed action itself, rather than explicitly distinguishing a predicted future outcome from competing alternatives. More recent efforts have turned to regularizing the embedding distribution itself ( Bardes et al., 2021 ; Balestriero and LeCun, 2025 ; Maes et al., 2026 ) .
For instance, by employing Sketched Isotropic Gaussian Regularization (SIGReg) to encourage isotropic Gaussian latent spaces, LeWorldModel ( Maes et al., 2026 , LeWM;) trains a lightweight ViT that achieves results comparable to DINO-WM ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) while planning more than 50 × 50\times faster (Table 1 ).
blocks.zh:
在预测性世界模型中,已作出相当大的努力来学习不折不扣的表述。 防止代表崩溃的早期方法主要侧重于限制编码器更新,要么通过移动平均目标编码器(Asran等人,2023年;Bardes等人,2024年),要么通过冻结预先训练过的大型视觉编码器(Zhou等人,2024年;Assran等人,2025年). 这些方法稳定了预测目标,并取得了强大的经验成果. 然而,它们没有明确迫使表述区分不同的行动结果,而且冷冻编码方法还从它们经过预先训练的大型骨干中产生大量的计算间接费用。 或者,其他方法通过监督行动信息防止崩溃(Ivashkov等人,2026年;Zhang等人,2026年;Sobal等人,2026年)。 通过利用反向动力来从潜在的过渡或差异中恢复行动,这些方法成功地建立了有意义的国家表述。 然而,其监督信号本身就侧重于恢复已执行行动本身,而不是明确区分预期的未来结果和相互竞争的替代办法。 最近的努力已转向使嵌入式分布本身正规化(Bardes等人,2021年;Balestriero和LeCun,2025年;Maes等人,2026年)。
例如,LeWorldModel(Maes等人,2026年,LeWM;)通过使用Sketched Isotropic Gaussian正规化(SIGREG)来鼓励异热带高斯人的潜在空间,培训一种轻量级的VIT,取得与DINO-WM(周等人,2024年)相当的结果,同时计划更快地进行50x50x次(表1)。

blocks.en: However, SIGReg constrains embedding statistics without specifying which information to preserve, allowing static backgrounds to dominate while control-relevant state changes are suppressed. We term this failure static collapse . Figure 1 illustrates it on OGBench-Cube-RB, constructed by replacing distant background pixels in OGBench-Cube ( Park et al., 2025 ) while preserving the robot and cube. LeWM’s t-SNE embeddings cluster tightly within each episode despite changes in manipulation state, and its planning success drops substantially relative to the original dataset. These results show that statistical regularization alone does not ensure preservation of the state distinctions needed for control.
blocks.zh: 然而,SIGREG限制嵌入统计而不指定要保存哪些信息,允许静态背景占主导地位,同时抑制与控制相关的状态变化. 我们称之为故障静态崩溃。 图1在OGBench-Cube-RB上对此进行了说明,通过在OGBench-Cube中替换远方背景像素(Park等人,2025年)来构建,同时保留机器人和立方体. LeWM的t-SNE在每集中紧紧嵌入集群,尽管操纵状态有所变化,其规划成功率与原始数据集相比大幅下降. 这些结果表明,仅靠统计规范化并不能确保保持控制所需的国家区别。

blocks.en: In this paper, we introduce motion-guided contrastive regularization for JEPA-style world models. Our approach is motivated by two key observations. First, distributional regularization, e.g., SIGReg, alone does not ensure that representations preserve state differences within the same environment. We therefore introduce a contrastive objective that compares the predicted action outcome with the observed next state and alternative states from the same episode. Because these observations share the same static scene, background identity alone cannot resolve the comparison, encouraging the model to capture changes in the robot and manipulated objects. Second, alternative states are not equally different from the observed outcome. Treating them all as negatives can push apart states that reflect similar manipulation outcomes, while measuring their similarity through pixel differences can be sensitive to irrelevant appearance variations. We therefore use optical flow to guide the contrastive objective, assigning greater similarity to alternatives whose motion resembles the observed transition. Together, these two ideas encourage the model to distinguish meaningful state changes while preserving similarities between related outcomes. Combined with latent prediction and SIGReg, our approach targets static collapse without relying on pixel reconstruction losses or auxiliary action-decoding objectives.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们引入了对JEPA风格世界模型进行运动制导的对比性规范化. 我们的做法有两项关键的意见。 首先,分配规范化,例如SIGREG, 单靠它并不能确保代表在同一环境中保持国家差异。 因此,我们提出一个对比性目标,将预测的行动结果与观察到的同一事件的下一个州和替代州进行比较。 因为这些观测都共享同一个静态场景,因此仅靠背景身份无法解决比较问题,鼓励模型捕捉机器人和被操纵物体的变化. 第二,替代状态与观察到的结果不同。 把它们都当作负数来对待,可以将反映类似操纵结果的状态推开,同时通过像素差异来测量它们的相似性可以对不相关的外观变化敏感. 因此,我们利用光学流动来指导对比性目标,使运动与观察到的过渡相似的替代品具有更大的相似性。 这两个想法共同鼓励模型区分有意义的状态变化,同时保持相关结果的相似性. 我们的方法与潜在的预测和SIGREG相结合,以静态崩溃为目标,而不依赖于像素重建损失或辅助的动作解码目标.

blocks.en:
We evaluate our framework on the OGBench ( Park et al., 2025 ) and LIBERO ( Liu et al., 2023 ) benchmarks under varying levels of visual complexity. Through rigorous representation analysis and downstream planning evaluations, our experiments reveal that while static collapse fundamentally impairs standard SIGReg-regularized models, our proposed contrastive objective effectively circumvents this failure. Ultimately, our approach yields substantial improvements in planning performance amid increased background diversity and scene clutter.
As a result, our method substantially boosts planning robustness under challenging visual conditions, increasing success rates from 52% to 78% on OGBench-Cube with randomized backgrounds and from 14% to 54% on LIBERO-Object compared to LeWM.
blocks.zh:
我们对OGBench(Park等人,2025年)和LIBERO(Liu等人,2023年)在视觉复杂程度不同下的基准框架进行评估。 通过严格的表述分析和下游规划评价,我们的实验表明,虽然静态崩溃从根本上损害了标准SIGREG规范化模型,但我们提出的对比性目标有效地避免了这种失败。 归根结底,在背景多样性和场景杂乱无章的情况下,我们的做法在规划业绩方面大有改进。
因此,我们的方法大大提高了在具有挑战性的视觉条件下规划的稳健性,使具有随机背景的OGBench-Cube上的成功率从52%提高到78%,比LIBERO-Object上的成功率从14%提高到54%。

blocks.en: This paper contributes to JEPA world models as follows. First, we propose a motion-guided contrastive objective that explicitly preserves action-conditioned state changes in the learned latent space. Second, we introduce an optical-flow-based similarity measure that focuses the contrastive objective on meaningful scene dynamics rather than low-level visual differences. Third, we show across multiple benchmark datasets that our approach mitigates static-background-induced representation collapse and substantially improves planning performance under visually complex conditions.
blocks.zh: 本文对JEPA世界模式的贡献如下. 首先,我们提出一个运动制导的对比目标,明确保留在所学到的潜在空间中具有行动条件的状态变化。 其次,我们引入了光学流基相似度测量,将对比性目标聚焦于有意义的场景动态而不是低水平的视觉差异. 第三,我们通过多个基准数据集显示,我们的做法减轻了静态背景引起的代表性崩溃,并大大改善了在视觉复杂条件下的规划业绩。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Latent world models. Latent world models learn compact environment dynamics to support planning and policy learning. World Models ( Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018 ) , PlaNet ( Hafner et al., 2019b ) , Dreamer and DreamerV3 ( Hafner et al., 2019a ; Hafner et al., 2023 ) , and IRIS ( Micheli et al., 2022 ) learn to model dynamics and control in latent space, while supervising the process with observation reconstruction. MuZero ( Schrittwieser et al., 2020 ) , EfficientZero and EfficientZero V2 ( Ye et al., 2021 ; Wang et al., 2024a ) , TD-MPC ( Hansen et al., 2022 ) , and TD-MPC2 ( Hansen et al., 2024 ) learn reconstruction-free, task-oriented models whose representations are shaped by reward and value supervision. DreamerPro ( Deng et al., 2022 ) , MuDreamer ( Burchi and Timofte, 2024 ) , and Dreamer-CDP ( Hauri and Zenke, 2026 ) also combine reconstruction-free representation learning with reward-driven control.
blocks.zh: 后期世界模型. 后期世界模式学习紧凑的环境动态,以支持规划和政策学习。 世界模式 (Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018), PlaNet (Hafner等人, 2019b), Dreamer and DreamerV3(Hafner等人, 2019a;Hafner等人, 2023),以及IRIS (Micheri等人, 2022) 学习模拟潜伏空间的动态和控制,同时通过观测重建来监督这一过程. MuZero(Schritwieser等人,2020年),"高效Zero与高效Zero V2(Ye等人,2021年;Wang等人,2024年a),TD-MPC(Hansen等人,2022年),TD-MPC2(Hansen等人,2024年)学习无重建,任务导向模式,其表述通过奖励和价值监督形成. DreamerPro (Deng et al., 2022年), 穆德雷默尔 (Burchi and Timofte, 2024),以及Dreamer-CDP(Hauri and Zenke, 2026)也将无重建代表学习与奖励驱动的控制结合起来.

blocks.en: JEPA methods, including I-JEPA ( Assran et al., 2023 ) and V-JEPA ( Bardes et al., 2024 ) , learn visual representations by predicting target embeddings without reconstructing pixels. For control, DINO-WM ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) , V-JEPA 2-AC ( Assran et al., 2025 ) , and JEPA-WM ( Terver et al., 2025 ) learn action-conditioned dynamics over pretrained visual representations, enabling image-goal planning without task-reward supervision. PLDM ( Sobal et al., 2026 ) and LeWM ( Maes et al., 2026 ) jointly learn the encoder and dynamics predictor from offline trajectories without observation reconstruction or task rewards. We focus on this end-to-end setting, where representations and dynamics can be learned together from offline interactions for image-goal planning. However, under joint optimization, latent prediction alone admits collapsed solutions, making the preservation of informative representations a central challenge.
blocks.zh: JEPA方法,包括I-JEPA(Asran等人,2023年)和V-JEPA(Bardes等人,2024年),通过预测目标嵌入而不重建像素来学习视觉表现. 为了控制,DINO-WM(周等人,2024年),V-JEPA 2-AC(Assran等人,2025年),JEPA-WM(Terver等人,2025年)在事先训练的视觉表现上学习了行动条件的动态,使得图像目标规划能够不受任务奖励的监督. PLDM(Sobal等人,2026年)和LeWM(Maes等人,2026年)共同从离线轨迹中学习编码器和动态预测器,没有观测重建或任务奖励. 我们侧重于这种端到端的设定,从图像-目标规划的线下互动中可以共同学习表述和动态。 然而,在联合优化下,仅仅潜在的预测就承认了崩溃的解决办法,使保存信息性陈述成为一项核心挑战。

blocks.en: Representation collapse and anti-collapse regularization. Anti-collapse regularization promotes representation diversity during joint encoder–predictor training. VICReg ( Bardes et al., 2021 ) constrains feature variance and covariance, while SIGReg ( Balestriero and LeCun, 2025 ) , adopted by LeWM ( Maes et al., 2026 ) , encourages an isotropic Gaussian embedding distribution. However, statistical diversity alone does not ensure that representations preserve control-relevant information. Prior work has shown that JEPA models can favor static background features while failing to capture moving-object states ( Sobal et al., 2022 ) . Other approaches address this issue through task- or action-based supervision. Bisimulation-based encoders ( Toso et al., 2026 ) encourage representations that preserve behaviorally relevant distinctions while remaining invariant to distractors. PLDM ( Sobal et al., 2026 ) uses inverse-dynamics supervision to retain action information. Concurrent with our work, Sensorimotor World Models ( Ivashkov et al., 2026 ) and Delta-JEPA ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) also explore inverse-dynamics supervision for learning action-sensitive representations. Our method instead introduces a within-episode contrastive objective guided by motion similarity. It encourages predicted latent transitions to distinguish alternative outcomes while preserving similarities between related transitions, without requiring an auxiliary action decoder.
blocks.zh: 代表制崩溃和反混乱正规化. 在联合编码员-校长培训期间,反螺旋桨规范化促进了代表的多样性。 VICReg(Bardes等人,2021年)制约了特征差异和共变,而LEWM(Maes等人,2026年)通过的SIGREG(Balestriero and LeCun,2025年)则鼓励异地嵌入分布. 然而,仅靠统计多样性并不能确保表述保存与控制有关的信息。 先前的研究表明,JEPA模型可以偏向静态背景特征,而不能捕捉移动对象状态(Sobal等人,2022年)。 其他办法通过基于任务或行动的监督来解决这一问题。 基于比模的编码器(Toso等人,2026年)鼓励在行为上保持相关区别的表达,同时对分心器保持不常态. PLDM(Sobal等人,2026年)使用反动力学监督来保留动作信息. 配合我们的工作,森索里摩托尔世界模型公司(Ivashkov等人,2026年)和德尔塔-JEPA公司(Zhang等人,2026年)也探索对学习行动敏感表述的反动力学监督. 相反,我们的方法引入了一个以运动相似性为指南的周期内对比目标。 它鼓励预测潜在的过渡,以区分替代结果,同时保持相关过渡之间的相似性,而不需要辅助动作解码器。

blocks.en: Contrastive and motion-guided representation learning . Contrastive objectives enable latent prediction without requiring observation reconstruction ( van den Oord et al., 2018 ; Kipf et al., 2019 ) . Building on this idea, recent approaches apply contrastive supervision to action-conditioned prediction ( Zheng et al., 2023 ; Burchi and Timofte, 2025 ) and the learning of physical dynamics ( Martini et al., 2026 ) . The choice of negative samples also influences the learned representation: Gulati and Nemenman (2026) show that within-trajectory negatives suppress shortcuts based on trajectory-specific static noise and improve the recovery of underlying dynamical variables. In video representation learning, synthetic motion augmentations and complementary visual-motion objectives have been used to encourage motion-sensitive features ( Thoker et al., 2023 ; Han et al., 2020 ; Xiao et al., 2022 ) . Most closely related to our approach, Mahendran et al. (2018) supervise representations by aligning pixel-embedding similarity distributions with targets derived from optical-flow similarity. Our method combines within-episode contrastive sampling with motion-derived soft targets to explicitly structure action-conditioned latent transitions.
blocks.zh: 矛盾和动作指导性的代表学习 相互矛盾的目标使得潜在的预测无需观测重建成为可能(van den Oord等人,2018年;Kipf等人,2019年)。 基于这一想法,最近的办法对行动条件的预测(郑等人,2023年;Burchi和Timofte,2025年)和物理动力学的学习(Martini等人,2026年)进行了对比性监督。 负面样品的选择也影响了所学表现: 古拉蒂和内门曼(2026年)表明,内射负数抑制基于轨迹特定静态噪声的捷径,改善基础动态变量的恢复. 在视频表现学习中,采用了合成运动增强和互补的视觉运动目标来鼓励运动敏感特征(Thoker等人,2023年;Han等人,2020年;Shao等人,2022年)。 与我们的方法最密切相关的是,Mahendran等人(2018年)通过将类似像素混合的分布与光学流类似性产生的目标相匹配来监督表达. 我们的方法将集成体内对比性取样与运动产生的软目标相结合,以明确构建行动条件的潜在过渡。

blocks.en: 3 Preliminaries and static collapse
blocks.zh: 3 初步和静态坍塌

blocks.en: LeWorldModel. We build on LeWM ( Maes et al., 2026 ) , a JEPA-style world model trained end-to-end from visual observations. blocks.en: Static collapse. Although SIGReg is an effective regularizer and LeWM achieves promising results, it does not specify which information should be preserved in the latent representation. We identify a failure mode arising from this limitation: in environments with visually complex backgrounds, the encoder can satisfy the SIGReg objective by primarily encoding static scene appearance. Because background features already exhibit substantial diversity across observations, they provide an easy way to satisfy the Gaussianity constraint enforced by SIGReg, reducing the pressure to encode manipulation-relevant dynamics. Specifically, when background features alone are sufficient to achieve a low SIGReg loss, the learned representation tends to become dominated by those features:
blocks.zh: 静态崩溃。 虽然SIGREG是有效的常态化者,而LEWM则取得了有希望的结果,但它没有规定在潜在代表中应保留哪些信息。 我们识别出由这种限制产生的故障模式:在视觉复杂背景的环境中,编码器主要通过编码静态场景外观可以满足SIGREG目标. 由于背景特征在观测中已经表现出巨大的多样性,它们提供了满足SIGREG强制实施的高斯态约束的简单方法,降低了编码与操纵相关的动态的压力. 具体来说,当仅是背景特征就足以实现低SIGREG损失时,所学表现往往以这些特征为主:

where 𝐙 B \mathbf{Z}_{B} denotes background features and ϵ t \epsilon_{t} captures the remaining dynamic information. Consequently, changes induced by robot-object interactions contribute only weakly to the representation, leading to poor discrimination between manipulation states and degraded downstream control performance.

blocks.en: We use the single-cube manipulation environment from OGBench ( Park et al., 2025 ) , denoted Cube , and construct a paired variant, Cube-RB . For each episode in Cube-RB , we sample a background image from ImageNet ( Deng et al., 2009 ) and keep it fixed throughout the episode. Only distant pixels ( d ​ e ​ p ​ t ​ h ≥ 1.0 depth\geq 1.0 m) are replaced, leaving the robot arm, cube, actions, and underlying dynamics unchanged. As a result, Cube and Cube-RB differ only in the presence of episode-specific background variation. We train LeWM on both datasets using identical hyperparameters, thereby isolating the effect of complex static visual content. Figure 1 (B) visualizes the learned latent representations using t-SNE ( van der Maaten and Hinton, 2008 ) . On Cube , the embeddings distinguish different manipulation states within an episode. In contrast, on Cube-RB , embeddings cluster primarily according to background identity, causing visually distinct manipulation states to collapse into compact episode-specific groups despite substantial changes in the robot and cube configurations. This representation collapse is accompanied by a significant drop in planning performance. As shown in Figure 1 (C), LeWM’s success rate decreases from 74% on Cube to 52% on Cube-RB .

blocks.en: This failure mode motivates our motion-guided contrastive objective. By contrasting candidate states within the same scene, the objective prevents the model from relying on static background cues and instead encourages representations that capture task-relevant dynamics.
blocks.zh: 这种失败模式激发了我们运动引导的对比目标. 通过与同一场景中候选国家形成对比,目标阻止了模型依赖静态背景提示,而是鼓励能够捕捉与任务相关的动态的表达.

blocks.en: 4 Motion-Guided Contrastive Regularization
blocks.zh: 4 动议指导对照规范化

blocks.en: We introduce our motion-guided contrastive objective in this section. We train an action-conditioned world model to distinguish the observed next state from alternative states within the same episode, using optical-flow similarity to assign soft contrastive targets. Comparing states within an episode reduces the usefulness of static background identity, while motion-based targets account for alternatives that represent similar transitions.
blocks.zh: 我们在本节介绍我们的行动指导对比目标。 我们训练一种有行动条件的世界模型,以区分观察到的下一个状态和同一事件内的其他状态,利用光学流相似性来指定软对比目标. 比较某一事件内的状态会减少静态背景特征的用处,而基于运动的目标则会说明代表类似过渡的替代品.

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Benchmark datasets. We evaluate on six visual-control settings. The controlled pair introduced in Section 3 , Cube ( Park et al., 2025 ) and Cube-RB (Cube with randomized backgrounds), isolates the effect of episode-specific background variation. We additionally evaluate on LIBERO-Object ( Liu et al., 2023 ) to assess whether the benefits extend to multi-object scenes without synthetic background replacement. For LIBERO-Object, we expand the training data with noise-perturbed expert trajectories. Appendix A.1 details this data preparation and evaluation protocol. Finally, we evaluate on Push-T ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) , 2-Rooms ( Sobal et al., 2026 ) , and Reacher ( Tassa et al., 2018 ) , following prior world-model evaluations ( Zhou et al., 2024 ; Maes et al., 2026 ) , to assess whether our objective maintains performance in visually simpler environments.
blocks.zh: 基准数据集。 我们评价六个视觉控制设置 第3节Cube(Park等人,2025年)和Cube-RB(具有随机背景的Cube)中引入的控制对子,隔离了各集特定背景变异的效果. 我们还对LIBERO-Object(Liu等人,2023年)进行了评估,以评估这些好处是否扩大到了没有合成背景替代的多对象场景。 对于LIBERO-Object,我们用噪音扰动的专家轨迹扩充训练数据. 附录A.1详细列出了这一数据编制和评价协议。 最后,我们评价了Push-T(周等人,2024年),2-Rooms(Sobal等人,2026年)和Reacher(Tassa等人,2018年),此前进行了世界模式评价. (周 al等人,2024年;梅斯等人,2026年),评估我们的目标在视觉上简单的环境中是否保持性能.

blocks.en: Baseline models. We compare against four learned world-model baselines. LeWM ( Maes et al., 2026 ) is our backbone, trained with its original prediction and SIGReg objectives without the proposed contrastive loss. Sensorimotor World Models (SMWM) ( Ivashkov et al., 2026 ) encourages action-sensitive representations through an auxiliary action-decoding objective. PLDM ( Sobal et al., 2026 ) combines latent prediction with VICReg-inspired regularization and an auxiliary inverse-dynamics objective. DINO-WM ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) learns dynamics over frozen DINOv2 features ( Oquab et al., 2023 ) , providing a reference based on large-scale visual pretraining; unlike the other methods, it is not trained end-to-end on task data, and we mark it with † in Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 基线模型。 我们比较了四个学习过的世界模式基线。 LeWM(Maes 等人,2026年)是我们的骨干力量,经过培训后实现了最初的预测和SIGREG目标,没有拟议的对比性损失. Sensorimotor World Models(SMWM)(Ivashkov等人,2026年)鼓励通过辅助的动作解码目标来进行对动作敏感的表示. PLDM(Sobal等人,2026年)将潜在预测与VICReg启发的规范化和辅助反动力学目标结合起来. DINO-WM(周永康等人,2024年)在冷冻的DINOv2特征上学习动态(Oquab等人,2023年),提供基于大规模视觉预训的参考;与其他方法不同的是,它没有在任务数据上经过端到端的训练,我们用表1中的Q来标注.

blocks.en: Training details. All methods are trained on the same task data and observation augmentations for 100 epochs, using a batch size of 128 and a learning rate of 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} . LeWM and our method share identical architectures and optimization settings, differing only in the addition of our motion-guided contrastive objective. Following LeWM ( Maes et al., 2026 ) , we use M = 1024 M=1024 random projections for SIGReg and set its regularization weight to λ = 0.09 \lambda=0.09 . We compute optical flow using SEA-RAFT ( Wang et al., 2024b ) . For each training transition, we sample N = 6 N=6 additional candidate observations from the same episode. We set the flow temperature to τ f = 20 \tau_{f}=20 , the latent temperature to τ z = 0.1 \tau_{z}=0.1 , and the contrastive loss weight to β = 0.3 \beta=0.3 . We analyze sensitivity to the temperatures τ f \tau_{f} and τ z \tau_{z} , the number of additional candidates N N , the SIGReg weight λ \lambda , and the contrastive loss weight β \beta in Appendix B .

blocks.en: Evaluation via latent planning. We evaluate the learned world models through image-goal planning using a shared, sampling-based model-predictive control (MPC) procedure. Following LeWM ( Maes et al., 2026 ) , we encode the current and goal observations and predict latent rollouts for candidate action sequences. The Cross-Entropy Method (CEM) ( Rubinstein, 1999 ) optimizes these sequences by minimizing the squared Euclidean distance between the predicted terminal embedding and the goal embedding. Holding the controller fixed across methods evaluates how well their learned representations and dynamics support goal-directed control. Our comparison focuses on offline, reward-free world models used within this common planning framework. To compare computational cost, we also report the peak GPU memory ( Peak GPU mem. ) and the wall-clock planning time ( Planning time ) required to plan one trajectory. Appendix A.2 provides the planning configuration and evaluation protocol.
blocks.zh: 通过潜在规划进行评价。 我们通过图像-目标规划,利用一个基于抽样的模型-预测控制程序,来评价学到的知识的世界模型。 继LeWM(Maes等人,2026年)之后,我们编码了当前和目标观测,并预测候选行动序列的潜在推出。 Cross-Entropy Method(CEM)(Rubinstein,1999年)通过最小化预测终端嵌入与目标嵌入之间的平方欧几利得距离来优化这些序列. 拥有不同方法的固定控制器,可以评价他们学到的表达和动态如何支持目标导向的控制。 我们的比较侧重于在这一共同规划框架内使用的离线、无报酬的世界模式。 为了比较计算成本,我们还报告规划一个轨迹所需的峰值GPU内存(峰值GPU mem.)和墙点规划时间(规划时间. 附录A.2提供了规划配置和评价协议。

blocks.en: 5.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 5.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Table 1 shows that motion-guided contrastive regularization substantially improves planning success over LeWM on Cube-RB and LIBERO-Object. On Cube-RB, success increases from 52% to 78%, a gain of 26 percentage points under background randomization. On LIBERO-Object, success under our image-goal planning protocol increases from 14% to 54%, extending the benefits to multi-object scenes, where the task-irrelevant static objects can cause similar static collapse behavior as in Cube-RB. On Cube, Push-T, 2-Rooms, and Reacher, our method’s success rates remain on par. In particular, our method achieves 76% on Cube and 78% on Cube-RB, maintaining similar observed performance despite the introduction of episode-specific backgrounds, indicating the effectiveness of our method in preserving task-relevant information. Among the evaluated end-to-end world models, our method achieves the highest observed LIBERO-Object success rate. DINO-WM achieves higher success on this setting using its frozen pretrained visual encoder. On Cube-RB, our method matches SMWM at 78%. These comparisons demonstrate substantial improvements over the LeWM backbone.
blocks.zh: 表1显示,与立方体-RB和LIBERO-Object相比,运动制导对比性规范化大大改善了规划的成功。 在Cube-RB上,成功率从52%上升到78%,在背景随机化下增高26个百分点. 在LIBERO-Object上,在我们图像-目标规划协议下的成功率从14%增加到54%,将好处扩展到多对象场景,在那里,与任务无关的静态物体会导致类似立方体-RB中的静态崩溃行为. 在Cube、Push-T、2-Rooms和Reacher上, 特别是,我们的方法在立方体上达到了76%,在立方体-RB上达到了78%,尽管引入了各集的特定背景,但保持了类似的观测性能,表明我们的方法在保存任务相关信息方面的有效性. 在经过评价的端到端世界模型中,我们的方法实现了观测到的最高LIBERO-Object成功率. DINO-WM在此设置上使用其被冷冻的前置视觉编码器取得了更高的成功. 在立方体RB上,我们的方法与SMWM匹配为78%. 这些比较表明,与LEWM主干网相比,有了很大的改进。

blocks.en: Decodability of manipulation state. Following Maes et al. (2026) , we train a lightweight transformer decoder to reconstruct observations from a single latent embedding. The world-model parameters remain frozen during decoder training, providing a qualitative probe of the visual information recoverable from each representation. Figure 3 compares reconstructions on Cube, Cube-RB, and LIBERO-Object (ground truth, LeWM, ours). Reconstructions from LeWM latents retain the coarse scene layout but blur the manipulated object and end effector. Reconstructions from our latents more clearly depict object locations and gripper configurations. These results suggest that motion-guided contrastive supervision makes manipulation-relevant visual information more accessible to the decoder.
blocks.zh: 操纵状态的可解析性. 继Maes等人(2026年)之后,我们培训一个轻量级变压器解码器,以便从单一的潜在嵌入物中重建观测。 世界模型参数在解码器培训期间仍然被冻结,为从每个代表处可收回的视觉信息提供质的探测。 图3比较了Cube、Cube-RB和LIBERO-Object上的重建(地面真相、LEWM、我们的)。 LeWM潜伏器的重建保留了粗糙的场景布局,但模糊了被操纵的对象和终端效应器. 从我们潜伏中的重建 更清楚地描绘了物体的位置 和捕捉器的配置 这些结果表明,运动制导的对比性监督使解码器更容易获得与操纵相关的视觉信息.

blocks.en: Attention maps. We visualize the encoder’s spatial focus when forming the global latent embedding by aggregating patch attention weights across all layers (Figure 4 ). Rows show the input image and the attention maps for LeWM and our method. On Cube-RB and LIBERO-Object, LeWM assigns substantial attention to background regions and static objects, whereas our method focuses more strongly on the manipulated object and gripper. These patterns complement the reconstruction results and suggest greater emphasis on manipulation-relevant regions.

blocks.en: We ablate contrastive supervision and SIGReg on Cube-RB and LIBERO-Object, retaining the prediction loss in all variants. As shown in Table 3 , adding InfoNCE to LeWM increases planning success from 52% to 56% on Cube-RB and from 14% to 34% on LIBERO-Object. Our motion-guided objective further increases success to 78% and 54%, exceeding InfoNCE by 22 and 20 percentage points, respectively. These gains support the benefit of incorporating observed motion similarities into contrastive supervision. Removing SIGReg from the full objective reduces success from 78% to 58% on Cube-RB and from 54% to 14% on LIBERO-Object. These results indicate that motion-guided supervision and batch-level distributional regularization make complementary contributions.
blocks.zh: 我们在立方体-RB和LIBERO-Object上降低对比性监控和SIGrag,保留所有变体的预测损失. 如表3所示,将InfoNCE添加到LEWM中,将立方体RB中的计划成功率从52%提高到56%,而LIBERO-Object中的计划成功率从14%提高到34%。 我们的运动指导目标进一步将成功率提高到78%和54%,分别超过了InfoNCE的22和20个百分点. 这些收益支持将观察到的运动相似性纳入对比性监督的好处。 从全部目标中删除SIGREG将使立方体-RB的成功率从78%降至58%,LIBERO-Object的成功率从54%降至14%。 这些结果表明,流动指导监督和批量分配正规化可起到补充作用。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We identified static collapse in JEPA-style world models, where representations preserve episode-specific static content while suppressing manipulation-relevant changes. We introduced motion-guided contrastive regularization, which uses optical flow to guide comparisons among observations from the same episode. Combined with latent prediction and SIGReg, it improves planning success from 52% to 78% on Cube-RB and from 14% to 54% on LIBERO-Object, with comparable performance on four other settings. Representation analyses and ablations support improved preservation of manipulation state and the complementary role of SIGReg.
blocks.zh: 我们在JEPA风格的世界模型中发现了静态崩溃,其中的表述保留了特定事件静态内容,同时抑制了与操纵相关的变化. 我们引入了运动导对比性规范化,它使用光学流来指导同一集的观测对比. 它与潜在预测和SIGREG相结合,提高了立方体RB52%至78%以及LIBERO-Object的14%至54%的规划成功率,其他四个环境的性能相当。 代表性分析和模拟有助于更好地维护操纵状态和SIGREG的补充作用。

blocks.en:
Limitation and future work .
Like LeWM, our method depends on sufficient action coverage and remains sensitive to shifts in action representations and visual appearance, including changes to LIBERO’s rendering engine. It also assumes static backgrounds; background motion could distort the optical-flow similarities used for supervision. Future work should improve transfer across actions and appearances, isolate task-relevant motion in dynamic scenes, and extend planning to longer horizons.
blocks.zh:
限制和今后的工作
与LEWM一样,我们的方法取决于足够的动作覆盖度,并且对动作表现和视觉外观的转变,包括LIBERO渲染引擎的改变保持敏感. 它还假定了静态背景;背景运动可能扭曲用于监督的光学流相似性. 今后的工作应改善跨行动和外观的转移,在动态场景中孤立与任务有关的运动,并将规划扩大到更长的视野。

blocks.en: A.1 LIBERO-Object Data Preparation
blocks.zh: A.1 LIBERO-目标数据编制

blocks.en: Dataset partitioning. We use all tasks in LIBERO-Object, which provides 500 expert trajectories. Before generating additional data, we reserve three expert trajectories per task for evaluation and use the remaining trajectories for training. We generate perturbed continuations only from training trajectories, ensuring that held-out trajectories and their continuations are excluded from the training data.
blocks.zh: 数据集分区. 我们使用LIBERO-Object中的所有任务,它提供了500个专家的轨迹. 在生成额外数据之前,我们保留了每项任务的三个专家轨道以供评估,并利用其余的轨道进行培训。 我们只能从培训轨迹中产生扰动的继续,确保被搁置的轨迹及其继续被排除在培训数据之外。

blocks.en: Perturbed trajectory generation. To increase training diversity around the demonstrated behaviors, we generate additional trajectories by perturbing expert actions. For each training trajectory, we uniformly sample three valid starting frames without replacement. At each starting frame, we restore the recorded simulator state and execute three perturbed continuations of up to 100 steps each, yielding nine rollouts per training demonstration.
blocks.zh: 扰动轨迹生成. 为了增加围绕所展示的行为的训练多样性,我们通过扰动专家行动产生更多的轨迹. 对于每个训练轨迹,我们统一抽取三个没有替换的有效起始架. 在每个起始框架上,我们恢复了记录的模拟状态,并进行了三次扰动的续作,每次可达100步,每次训练演示可产生9次展开.

blocks.en: We perturb the continuous pose components of the expert action sequence with zero-mean Gaussian noise and clip the resulting actions to [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] . The three variants use noise standard deviations σ ∈ { 0.15 , 0.33 , 0.5 } \sigma\in\{0.15,0.33,0.5\} , paired with per-step gripper-flip probabilities p ∈ { 0.006 , 0.03 , 0.09 } p\in\{0.006,0.03,0.09\} , respectively. For each continuation, the discrete gripper command is initialized from the expert command at the starting frame and subsequently undergoes stochastic sign flips with the corresponding probability. We record the executed actions and resulting simulator observations.
blocks.zh: 我们用零度高斯噪音干扰专家行动序列的连续布置部分,并将由此产生的动作剪辑到[− 1, 1][-1,1]. 三种变体使用噪声标准偏差= {{ 0.15, 0.33, 0.5}\sigma\in { 0.15, 0.33, 0.5} , 配对为每步抓取概率 p { 0.006, 0.03, 0.09} 分别为p\ in 0.006, 0.03, 0.09}. 对于每次续作,离散的抓取器命令在起始帧时从专家命令中初始化,然后进行具有相应概率的斜拉式符号翻转. 我们记录了已执行的行动 以及由此产生的模拟观测结果

blocks.en: Filtering and dataset composition. We discard a rollout if it contains fewer than five recorded steps, if the target object’s vertical coordinate falls below z = − 0.60 z=-0.60 at any recorded step in simulator coordinates, or if the Euclidean displacement between its first and last recorded positions is less than 0.03 ​ m 0.03\,\mathrm{m} . We also tag distractor motion when the first-to-last change in selected static object-state coordinates has an ℓ 2 \ell_{2} norm greater than 0.05 0.05 . Rollouts exhibiting distractor motion are retained and assigned the tag distractor_moved=1 .
blocks.zh: 过滤和数据集组成。 如果目标物体的垂直坐标低于 z = − 0.60 z = - 0.60 在模拟坐标的任何记录步骤上, 或者如果Euclidean在第一个和最后一个记录位置之间的移位小于 0.03 m 0.03\\\\ mathrm{ m} , 我们放弃推出。 当选定静止物体状态坐标的第一到最后一次变化,规范大于0.05 0.05时,我们也标记分心器运动。 显示分心器运动的滚动被保留,并指定标记分心器_moved=1.

blocks.en: After filtering, we retain 4,108 perturbed trajectory chunks, which are combined with the training expert trajectories. All methods evaluated on LIBERO-Object use this same expanded training dataset, with one model per method trained jointly across all LIBERO-Object tasks.
blocks.zh: 经过过滤后,我们保留了4,108个扰动轨迹块,它们与训练专家轨迹相结合。 在LIBERO-Object上评价的所有方法都使用同样的扩展培训数据集,每个方法有一个模式,在所有LIBERO-Object任务中共同培训。

blocks.en: A.2 Latent Planning and Evaluation Protocol

blocks.en: CEM and replanning. At each control step, CEM performs 10 optimization iterations, sampling 128 candidate action sequences per iteration. The 16 sequences with the lowest predicted costs form the elite set used to update the sampling distribution. One control step spans five environment timesteps, with observations sampled at this interval. Each evaluation instance has a total execution budget of five control steps, corresponding to 25 environment timesteps. After optimization, we execute only the first action of the selected sequence, obtain a new observation after one control step, and replan toward the same goal. The planning horizon matches the remaining execution budget, decreasing from five to one control step over successive replanning rounds: H ∈ { 5 , 4 , 3 , 2 , 1 } H\in\{5,4,3,2,1\} .

All methods are evaluated on the same initial–goal pairs, and we use the final saved training checkpoint for each method. Success rates are computed over the 50 evaluation instances in each benchmark setting.

The absolute difference between each joint angle and its goal value must be less than 0.05 0.05 radians, following the qpos_match configuration. • 2-Rooms. The Euclidean distance between the agent’s center and its goal position must be less than 16 pixels in the 224 × 224 224\times 224 environment coordinate system. • Cube and Cube-RB. The Euclidean distance between the cube’s 3D position and its goal position must be at most 0.04 ​ m 0.04\,\mathrm{m} . Cube orientation is excluded from the success criterion. blocks.en: A.3 Model and Training Implementation
blocks.zh: A.3 模式和培训实施

blocks.en: Visual encoder. We use a ViT-Tiny/14 encoder trained from scratch, with 12 transformer blocks, 192-dimensional tokens, 3 attention heads, and 768-dimensional feed-forward layers with GELU. Each 224 × 224 224\times 224 RGB image is divided into 256 non-overlapping 14 × 14 14\times 14 patches, supplemented with a learned CLS token and learned positional embeddings. The final CLS feature passes through a projection head consisting of a linear layer from 192 to 2048 dimensions, BatchNorm, GELU, and a linear layer back to 192 dimensions.
blocks.zh: 视觉编码器. 我们使用一个从零开始训练的ViT-Tiny/14编码器,有12个变压器块,192维符号,3个注意力头,以及768维的饲料前向层与GELU. 每224×224/224\times 224 RGB图像被分为256个非重叠 14×14 14\times 14个补丁,并辅以学习过的CLS符号和学习的定位嵌入. 最终的CLS特征穿过一个投影头,由192到2048维的线性层,BatchNorm,GELU,以及一个线性层回溯到192维的线性层组成.

blocks.en: Temporal predictor. Observations are encoded independently and passed to an action-conditioned causal transformer with 6 blocks, 16 attention heads, 64 dimensions per head, and 2048-dimensional feed-forward layers. The predictor’s input and output dimensions are both 192. Each training clip contains three context observations and one future observation, sampled at intervals of five environment timesteps. Using the subsampled time index of the main text, the predictor uses ( 𝐱 t − 2 , 𝐱 t − 1 , 𝐱 t ) (\mathbf{x}_{t-2},\mathbf{x}_{t-1},\mathbf{x}_{t}) and the associated actions to predict the embedding of 𝐱 t + 1 \mathbf{x}_{t+1} .
blocks.zh: 时间预测器。 观测数据独立编码,并传递给行动条件的因果变压器,其中6块,16个注意力头,每头64维,2048维向导层. 预测器的输入和输出维度都是192. 每个培训片段包含3个背景观测和1个未来观测,每隔5个环境时段进行取样。 使用正文的子样本时间索引,预测器使用(x t − 2, x t − 1, x t) (\ mathbf{ x}_{t-2},\ mathbf{ x}_{t-1},\ mathbf{ x}_{t}) 和相关动作预测 x t + 1\ mathbf{ x}_{t+1} 的嵌入.

blocks.en: Optimization. LeWM and our method share the same architecture and optimization settings, differing only in the addition of the motion-guided contrastive objective. We train for 100 epochs with a batch size of 128 using AdamW, a learning rate of 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} , weight decay of 10 − 3 10^{-3} , momentum coefficients ( 0.9 , 0.999 ) (0.9,0.999) , and ϵ = 10 − 8 \epsilon=10^{-8} . The learning rate follows a linear warmup followed by cosine decay.

blocks.en:
Candidate sampling and motion supervision. We compute optical flow using the pretrained SEA-RAFT ( Wang et al., 2024b ) Spring-M checkpoint MemorySlices/Tartan-C-T-TSKH-spring540x960-M .
The flow model is frozen and runs in evaluation mode with four refinement iterations and scale=0 . Flow is computed at 224 × 224 224\times 224 resolution, with displacement vectors measured in pixels at that resolution. The offline pipeline converts stored RGB frames to channel-first floating-point tensors in [ 0,255 ] [0,255] , which SEA-RAFT internally normalizes to [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] . No additional resizing or augmentation is applied during flow precomputation for the native 224 × 224 224\times 224 frames.

流量模型被冻结,在评价模式下运行,有4个精细迭代和比例尺=0. 流量按224x224x224\times 224的分辨率计算,在分辨率上以像素计量移动矢量。 离线输油管将存储的RGB帧转换为[0,255] [0,255]中的通道-第一浮点计数器,SEA-RAFT在内部将它正常化为[− 1, 1] [-1, 1]. 在对原生224×224\224\224帧进行流量预计算时,不采用额外的再缩放或增量.

blocks.en: For each anchor frame 𝐱 t \mathbf{x}_{t} , we randomly sample 40 candidate frames from any other timestep of the same episode, excluding the current frame 𝐱 t \mathbf{x}_{t} and the positive frame 𝐱 t + 1 \mathbf{x}_{t+1} , and precompute their motion-weighted distances d t , j d_{t,j} (Eq. 9 ) from the anchor-to-positive and anchor-to-candidate flow fields. Only these scalar distances are cached, in float32 format; the dense flow fields are not retained. During training, we randomly draw N N of the 40 cached candidates for each transition ( N = 6 N=6 by default) and construct the soft contrastive targets from their cached distances. SEA-RAFT inference is therefore performed entirely offline, and no flow model is run during world-model training.

blocks.en: Training objective. We retain LeWM’s latent prediction loss and SIGReg regularization, and add the motion-guided contrastive loss defined in the main text. SIGReg is applied to the pre-projection encoder embeddings of the current and next observations, using M = 1024 M=1024 random projections and regularization weight λ = 0.09 \lambda=0.09 . Unless otherwise specified, the contrastive objective uses τ f = 20 \tau_{f}=20 , τ z = 0.1 \tau_{z}=0.1 , and β = 0.3 \beta=0.3 .

blocks.en: A.4 Representation Analysis Implementation
blocks.zh: A.4 代表分析的执行情况

blocks.en: Frozen-representation evaluation. We assess the information retained by the learned representations through image reconstruction and physical-state probing. For each method, we freeze the world-model parameters and train auxiliary decoders or probes on the resulting embeddings. Only the auxiliary model is optimized during these analyses.
blocks.zh: 冻结代表评价. 我们通过图像重建和实体状态检测来评估学到的信息。 对于每一种方法,我们都会冻结世界模型参数,并在由此产生的嵌入物上训练辅助解码器或探测器. 在这些分析中,只有辅助模型得到优化。

blocks.en: Image reconstruction. We train a lightweight transformer decoder to reconstruct an observation from its corresponding latent embedding. These reconstructions provide a qualitative assessment of the visual information recoverable from each representation, particularly the configurations of the robot and manipulated objects.
blocks.zh: 图像重建. 我们训练一个轻量级变压器解码器 从它相应的潜伏中重建一个观测。 这些重建对从每个表述中可收回的视觉信息,特别是机器人和被操纵物体的配置进行了定性评估。

blocks.en: On Cube and Cube-RB, both methods use the same episode-level partition, with 9,000 training episodes and 1,000 validation episodes, so all clips from a given episode remain within a single subset.
blocks.zh: 在Cube和Cube-RB上,两种方法都使用相同的插曲级别分区,有9000个训练集和1000个验证集,因此一个特定插曲的所有剪辑都保留在一个子集内.

blocks.en: For LIBERO-Object, both methods use 47 source demonstrations per task for decoder training and three for validation. Perturbed continuations inherit the partition of their source demonstration, ensuring that each demonstration and its perturbed descendants remain in the same subset.
blocks.zh: 对于LIBERO-Object,两种方法都使用47个源演示,每个任务用于解码器训练,三个用于验证. 扰动的继续继承了他们源头演示的分割,确保了每次演示及其扰动的后代都留在同一个子集中.

blocks.en: Physical-state probing. We train two-layer MLP probes on frozen encoder embeddings to quantify the recoverability of manipulation-relevant state information. On Cube and Cube-RB, the probes predict the 3D positions of the end effector and cube. On LIBERO-Object, they predict the end-effector position and a binary object-holding indicator. We measure position-prediction errors using Euclidean distance in centimeters and evaluate object-holding classification using the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC).
blocks.zh: 物理状态检测. 我们在冷冻编码器嵌入器上训练两层的MLP探测器,以量化与操纵相关的状态信息的可回收性. 在立方体和立方体-RB上,探测器预测了最终效应器和立方体的3D位置. 在LIBERO-Object上,他们预测端效应位置和二进制对象持有指示器. 我们利用Euclidean在厘米的距离测量位置预测误差,并利用接收器操作特征曲线(AUROC)下的区域评价物体持有分类。

blocks.en: The numerical probing experiments use episode-level partitions into disjoint training, validation, and test subsets. For each of Cube and Cube-RB, these subsets contain 7,000, 1,500, and 1,500 episodes, respectively, corresponding to 56,000, 12,000, and 12,000 frames. For LIBERO-Object, they contain 350, 70, and 80 episodes, corresponding to 10,850, 2,160, and 2,487 frames. All frames from a given episode remain within a single subset.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 4 (a), planning success reaches 54% at τ f = 20 \tau_{f}=20 , the highest result among the tested settings. Success is lower at both smaller and larger temperatures, ranging from 36% to 46% for τ f ∈ { 2.5 , 5 , 10 } \tau_{f}\in\{2.5,5,10\} and from 34% to 40% for τ f ∈ { 40 , 80 } \tau_{f}\in\{40,80\} . These results favor an intermediate temperature within the tested range. We use τ f = 20 \tau_{f}=20 in the main experiments.
blocks.zh: 如表4(a)所示,规划成功率在 \ f = 20\ tau\ f\ 20 时达到 54%,是测试设置中最高的结果。 在较小和较大的温度下,成功率较低,从36%到46%不等,在 { 2.5, 5, 10 }\tau_{f}\in 2.5, 5, 10 \},从 34%到 40%不等,在 { { 40, 80 }\tau_{f}\in { 40, 80 \}。 这些结果有利于试验范围内的中间温度。 我们在主要实验中使用了\ f = 20\ tau\ f\ 20。

blocks.en: B.2 Latent Temperature τ z \tau_{z}
blocks.zh: B.2 低温\ tau_{z}

blocks.en: The latent temperature τ z \tau_{z} controls how cosine similarities between predicted and candidate latent transitions are mapped to a probability distribution. Smaller values produce sharper distributions, while larger values produce smoother distributions. Thus, τ z \tau_{z} controls the predicted distribution, whereas τ f \tau_{f} controls the motion-derived supervision targets.
blocks.zh: 潜在温度 \ tau_{z} 控制预测和候选潜在过渡之间的余弦相似度如何映射到概率分布 。 更小的值产生更尖锐的分布,而更大的值产生更平滑的分布. 因此, \ z\ tau_{z} 控制了预测的分布, 而\ f\ tau_{f} 控制了运动产生的监督目标。

blocks.en: Table 4 (b) shows that planning success ranges from 52% to 54% for τ z ∈ { 0.02 , 0.05 , 0.1 } \tau_{z}\in\{0.02,0.05,0.1\} , compared with 44%–50% for the larger tested values. The highest observed success is shared by τ z = 0.05 \tau_{z}=0.05 and τ z = 0.1 \tau_{z}=0.1 . We use τ z = 0.1 \tau_{z}=0.1 in the main experiments.
B.3 Number of Additional Candidates N N
blocks.zh: B.3 新增候选人人数 N N

blocks.en: We vary the number of additional observations sampled from the same episode, evaluating N ∈ { 2 , 4 , 6 , 8 , 10 , 12 } N\in\{2,4,6,8,10,12\} while fixing τ f = 20 \tau_{f}=20 and τ z = 0.1 \tau_{z}=0.1 . Each comparison contains N + 1 N+1 candidates, including the true next observation.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 4 (c), increasing N N does not yield a monotonic improvement in planning success. The highest observed success is 58% at N = 12 N=12 , compared with 54% at our default N = 6 N=6 . We retain N = 6 N=6 to limit the number of additional observations encoded per training transition.
blocks.zh: 如表4(c)所示,增加N不会导致规划成功方面的单调改进。 观察到的最高成功率在N=12 N=12时为58%,而我们默认成功率为N=6 N=6。 我们保留 N = 6 N = 6,以限制每次训练过渡编码的额外观测次数.

blocks.en: B.4 SIGReg Weight λ \lambda
blocks.zh: B.4 SIGREG 重量

blocks.en: We examine the strength of distributional regularization by varying the SIGReg weight λ \lambda while fixing the contrastive loss weight at β = 0.3 \beta=0.3 . All configurations retain the prediction and motion-guided contrastive losses.
blocks.zh: 我们通过改变 SIGREG 重量 \\ lambda 来检查分布式规范化的强度,同时将对比性减重定在 β = 0.3\beta = 0.3 。 所有配置都保留了预测和运动导对比损失.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 4 (d), removing SIGReg yields 14% planning success, consistent with the ablation in Table 3 . Adding SIGReg increases success to 40% at λ = 0.03 \lambda=0.03 and 54% at both λ = 0.09 \lambda=0.09 and λ = 0.18 \lambda=0.18 , while λ = 0.3 \lambda=0.3 yields 50%. These results support the complementary role of distributional regularization alongside motion-guided supervision. We use λ = 0.09 \lambda=0.09 as the default.
blocks.zh: 如表4(d)所示,删除SIGREG后,规划成功率达到14%,与表3中的减少率相一致。 加入 SIGREG 将成功率提高至40%,在 QQ = 0.03\lambda = 0.03和 54%,同时在 QQ = 0.09\lambda = 0.09和 QQ = 0.18\lambda = 0.18,而 QQ = 0.3\lambda = 0.3 输出50%. 这些结果支持了分配规范化与流动指导监督的互补作用。 我们使用QQ=0.09\lambda=0.09作为默认值.

blocks.en: B.5 Contrastive Loss Weight β \beta
blocks.zh: B.5 对比性损失

blocks.en: We vary the weight β \beta of the motion-guided contrastive loss while fixing the SIGReg weight at λ = 0.09 \lambda=0.09 . This experiment evaluates how the strength of motion-guided supervision affects planning performance.
blocks.zh: 我们在将SIGREG重量固定在 = 0.09\lambda= 0.09 时,会改变运动导引对比性损失的重量β\β。 这一实验评价了运动制导监督的强度如何影响规划绩效.

blocks.en: Table 4 (e) shows that β = 0.1 \beta=0.1 and β = 0.3 \beta=0.3 both achieve the highest observed success of 54%. The settings β = 0.05 \beta=0.05 and β = 0.6 \beta=0.6 yield 50% and 52%, respectively, whereas increasing the weight to β = 1.0 \beta=1.0 reduces success to 38%. Thus, assigning greater weight to the contrastive objective does not necessarily improve planning performance. We retain β = 0.3 \beta=0.3 as the default.
blocks.zh: 表4(e)显示,β=0.1\β=0.1,β=0.3\β=0.3,两者都取得了54%的最高成功率。 β = 0.05\β = 0.05和β = 0.6\β = 0.6 分别得到50%和52%的产值,而将重量提高到β = 1.0\β = 1.0 将成功率降至38%。 因此,对对比性目标给予更大的重视并不一定能改善规划工作。 我们保留β=0.3\β=0.3作为默认值.
